figures.caption: Figure 1. A verified Dafny method for computing an arithmetic sum from 0 to n. Executable statements, highlighted in blue, implement the main loop. Method specifications, highlighted in green, use requires and ensures to specify input assumptions and output guarantees. Proof annotations, highlighted in orange, use invariant and assert to supply intermediate facts to the verifier in order to prove the postcondition.
Figure 4. Model ablation on the LCB-Pro-Dafny easy split. Bars report verified pass rate over 100 easy instances.
Figure 2. Cumulative AxDafny pass rate on DafnyBench vs. iteration budget across model settings. The primary feedback gains are heavily concentrated within the first 5 iterations.

Figure 3. Cumulative AxDafny pass rate on LCB-Pro-Dafny across difficulty splits. Accuracy scales steadily with an increased iteration budget across all levels. Compared to proof-hint filling on DafnyBench, end-to-end program synthesis derives more sustained benefits from more iterations.
